visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Night scene under a tent. A young woman wearing a brown tank top and a black beanie is adjusting a large blue tarp. A man with a headlamp on his forehead is seen from the neck up. The lighting is low, provided by headlamps. (2) Daylight transition. A blue tent sits in a wide grassy field with lush green mountains in the distance. Two scooters, one matte black and one dark green, are parked nearby. A woman in a pink shirt and the young woman wave. (3) Outdoor setting. The young woman and an older woman in a pink shirt hug and laugh joyfully. They are in front of a red brick architectural structure. Bright natural daylight. (4) Road sequence. The older woman, wearing a silver helmet and sunglasses, rides the black scooter on a winding mountain road surrounded by trees. (5) Activity montage. The women are seen setting up a tent, standing on a glass platform overlooking a waterfall, and soaking in an outdoor pool with mountainous scenery. (6) Close-up shot. The older woman points at a small red mark on her palm. A person in a black shirt examines the hand. The young woman looks toward the camera with a concerned expression. (7) Night scene returns. Inside a tent, the older woman stirs a pot of noodles. Outside, rain falls heavily on a blue tarp. The young woman and her partner struggle with ropes and poles in the dark. (8) Product showcase. The video focuses on the scooters on the grass. Close-ups of the 'SYM' logo, LED headlights, and the 'Fiddle' branding. The young woman and man ride the green scooter together on a forest road. (9) Final studio/outdoor blend. The black scooter is shown in high detail on grass with the 'SYM-Fiddle' text overlay.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female creator, 1 older female (mother), 1 male partner.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Lush green mountains, forest roads with yellow signage, a waterfall with a glass walkway, and a campsite on a grassy field.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy start with upbeat pop BGM featuring strong drum beats and synth layers. A female voice speaks with high arousal and fast pace, accompanied by comic 'boing' and 'whoosh' sound effects. (2) Music transitions to a gentler acoustic guitar-driven track. A narrative female voice provides steady commentary. Occasional laughter and ambient outdoor wind sounds are heard under the narration. (3) A sharp 'ding' SFX marks a transition. The vocal tone shifts to concern as a second female voice (older) expresses discomfort with rising intonation. Background chatter of other people is present. (4) Sound of heavy rain falling (broadband noise) becomes dominant alongside frantic vocalizations from a male and female voice. Metallic clinking sounds suggest tent poles hitting each other. (5) The BGM shifts to a clean, rhythmic electronic track with a professional broadcast feel. The main female voice enunciates clearly, highlighting features of a product. Low engine hum of a scooter is audible in some segments.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook (Mishap) -> Motivation (Gift) -> Experience (Activities) -> Conflict (Sting & Rain) -> Resolution (Product Highlight)
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share a personal family bonding trip while highlighting the convenience, safety, and features of SYM Fiddle scooters for motor-camping.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of SYM logos, naming specific scooter models (125 ABS, 158 DX), and detailing technical specs like fuel economy and ABS+TCS.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a 'disaster vlog' narrative to keep viewers engaged before transitioning into a standard product endorsement.
